reviews.author: Clarence Mills
reviews.text: Kevin and the team at Fiddlers Roofing did an outstanding job! From start to finish, the process was smooth, professional, and stress-free. Kevin was knowledgeable, honest, and took the time to explain everything clearly. The crew worked efficiently, kept the area clean, and completed the job on time. The quality of the workmanship is excellent, and the new roof looks fantastic. I truly appreciate the attention to detail and the great customer service. I highly recommend Kevin and Fiddlers Roofing to anyone looking for reliable and high-quality roofing work!

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: Kevin, the owner, spent 11 months working with me and walking me through the unbearable hoops with my insurance claim from a hurricane last year. He went above and beyond and helped me by referring an AMAZING public adjuster and another contractor to do some other work. The staff, including Alexis and Ruben were fantastic as well. And the finished product? Absolutely amazing! Not only does my house look beautiful again, Ruben helped make it safer by pointing out where my roof needed improvement. Even if it were just Kevin, I would wholeheartedly recommend Fiddler’s Roofing to everyone, but with his top notch team, it’s a no brainer. Kevin also helped my sister get her roof fixed after the same storm, thankfully, her roof was only in need of minor repairs, but again, his crew got it done so it looked like it had never happened. I attached some before and after photos so you can see their work.

reviews.author: Nesa Downard
reviews.text: Found Fiddler’s after doing some searches and reading reviews, we got a good amount of quotes from other companies. Was looking for an entire new roof and gutters instillation . We decided to use Fiddler’s based on their reviews and how they approached getting our business. Kevin (the owner) came out to look at our very old roof and was very friendly and told me how they go about their process, he even gave me recommendations on things I should consider doing even if I don’t use them. With other roofing companies I met with, all they did was bad mouth other companies and how they were so much better. Fiddlers just focused on what they could/would do for us. I liked that they are a family owned business and they also use a family owned business for their gutters. The quote we received was a very good one with detailed options for us to choose from. Once we signed with them the process was quick, they came out shorty after and got started. The crew and Forman (David) were great, they answered any questions we had, and were so friendly. My roof was crazy old and as they removed the old roof they discovered some problems that they quickly assessed and handled. Our roof was done in two days and it looks beautiful. With the thousands of roofing companies here in Florida you never know who you can trust and what type of quality you will get. I’m so grateful we found Fiddlers. You can definitely trust them to do right by you and give you a quality roof. Highly recommend!
